mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as stronger economic activity boosts corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns despite a sustained quarterly rise in GDPC1 by >5% or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% signals tightening monetary policy, compressing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive 20d despite FEDFUNDS crossing above 4.5% or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly decline in FEDFUNDS below 3% and falling UNRATE below 4.5% signals dual accommodative policy and improving labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite both FEDFUNDS <3% and UNRATE <4.5% or interaction rank IC <0.05 over 20d window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO below 110 signals overcapacity in production during a late-cycle expansion, reducing growth prospects and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive 20d despite INDPRO crossing below 110 or Rank IC >0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in PAYEMS above 140,000 indicates expanding labor market participation, boosting consumer confidence and spending, which predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative within 5 days despite PAYEMS crossing above 140,000 or Rank IC <0.03 over the 5-day window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous quarterly rise in GDPC1 (demand) and RSAFS (demand in millions) signals robust economic activity, amplifying corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative despite both GDPC1 and RSAFS rising or interaction rank IC <0.05 over 20d window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO below 105 signals severe overcapacity in production, reducing growth expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive 60d despite INDPRO crossing below 105 or Rank IC >0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained FEDFUNDS above 5% in a post-shock recovery period signals persistent tightness, constraining growth and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS remains above 5% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX returns positive 20d despite FEDFUNDS remaining above 5% or Rank IC >0.03 over any 2-year window.
